product.name: WEG-Verwaltung (Condominium Management)
product.description: Management service for condominium owners' associations, handling administrative, financial, and legal tasks for properties of various sizes.

product.name: Mietverwaltung (Rental Management)
product.description: Service managing rental properties, including tenant relations, rent collection, and property maintenance.

product.name: Unterstützte Selbstverwaltung (Supported Self-Management)
product.description: An online platform enabling condominium owners to self-manage their property with expert support for complex issues.

product.name: Rundum-sorglos-Hausverwaltung (Full-Service Property Management)
product.description: Comprehensive property management where Matera handles all administrative, financial, and technical tasks for condominiums.

product.name: Fernverwaltung (Remote Property Management)
product.description: Digital property management service handling all administrative tasks remotely for condominiums nationwide.

product.name: Matera Online Platform
product.description: A digital platform providing transparency and tools for condominium management, including financial overview, document access, and communication.
